evidence_level: known-case source-semantics projection, NOT real SPARC execution or proven legal kernel config

assumptions.firmware_order: fixed ascending, includes boot0, no duplicates, all IDs < NR_CPUS
assumptions.environment: sequential/no concurrent mask mutation; callback order manually supplies of_iterate_over_cpus output; omitted paging/firmware path not proved

api_projection.set_cpu_possible: set/clear exact CPU-index bit in capacity8 bitmap
api_projection.num_possible_cpus: cpumask_weight -> bitmap_weight with small_cpumask_bits=NR_CPUS because NR_CPUS<=BITS_PER_LONG, not L
api_projection.find_last_bit: scan all NR_CPUS bits, exact highest set index or NR_CPUS if empty
api_projection.no_empty_mask: boot0 retained in this fixed projection
api_projection.bit_apis: narrow set/test/count semantics only; not Linux memory/IRQ/allocation implementation

observations: before_public_rebound: parent callback plus compaction vs fixed callback alone, before setup_nr_cpu_ids
after_public_rebound: exact setup_nr_cpu_ids source body, mask unchanged, nr_cpu_ids becomes highest possible index+1

contract.origin: researcher-refined, post-repair known-case development; not auto-extracted model requirement
contract.domain: F = initial_possible union firmware IDs; all provided inputs include boot0
required: possible subset of F: no invented identities
weight(possible) == min(weight(F), L): selection count under explicit projection
if weight(F)<=L, possible==F: no identity loss when not restricted
contract.optional_implementation_policy: first-L unique input identities with initial boot0 is diagnostic only, not universal normative requirement
unknown: dynamic/multiword cpumask projection outside these assumptions

model_original_predicates.all_present_possible: present subset possible, raw capacity8 bits, recorded separately
model_original_predicates.combined: all_present_possible and boot0 possible and bound; original proposed whole condition, not accepted oracle

inputs.origin: constructed dense same-cardinality contrast; not independent normal hardware
ID pattern described in selected historical repair; not reproduced device tree
constructed selection-limit boundary, not historical hardware

expected_before_execution.qualification: expectations from declared bitmask transformations and source-reviewed contract, not runtime ground truth

metamorphic_contrast: At each L compare dense01 vs sparse02 under rename 0->0,1->2. Same cardinality and boot0. Check whether possible outputs commute with rename. Reuses four runs per L; no extra executions, independent samples or hardware facts.
retries: no automatic compilation or execution retry; retain first failures and document any repair
